attack.note: Storm Bow (channeled, range grows while charging) is the main damage, but Flawless Technique, Sharpened Arrowheads and Giant Slayer all weave basic attacks between arrows, so autos matter in most builds.

poke.note: Storm Bow with Target Practice is one of the longest range pokes in the game, but it is a thin linear shot that a mobile hero sidesteps and a minion or tank blocks.

damage.note: Hits are large and aimed at one target (291 per Storm Bow, Dragon's Arrow up to 390 plus a stun), so a single heal per target has trouble outhealing a focused squishy. Measured 3223 hero damage per minute, high, but only 4079 siege, so the damage goes into heroes, not structures.

good_into.why: Storm Bow and Dragon's Arrow are skillshots, so heroes with no sidestep or gap closer eat every arrow and the Dragon's Arrow stun.
Flawless Technique and The Dragon Hungers stack burst on one target and Dragon's Arrow stuns several fragile heroes at once.
Giant Slayer deals 1.6 percent of maximum health per hit and Sharpened Arrowheads shreds armor, so large health pools are not a problem.
Area heals spread their output across the team while Hanzo piles damage on one target, so area healers undo less of it than a focused heal would.

bad_into.why: He has no self peel and Natural Agility is a 25 second cooldown jump that fast heroes can follow over the wall (Icy Veins notes this directly).
Storm Bow and Scatter Arrow are easy to dodge for fast heroes, and Target Practice becomes hard to complete.
A hero that disappears from sight and then dives ignores his vision tools and punishes his lack of defense, though Sonic Arrow reveals for a moment.
With no self sustain and a thin health pool, one dive combo kills him before Natural Agility returns.

wants_from_team: frontline that creates space and absorbs engages
crowd control to set up Storm Bow and Dragon's Arrow follow up
vision of terrain so Scatter Arrow and Natural Agility angles exist
a healer, because he has no sustain of his own
gives_team: Dragon's Arrow, a global stun that works as an engage or follow up
vision from Sonic Arrow in bushes and over walls
long range poke that forces enemies off objectives
Bullseye stun to cancel channels from afar
weaknesses: very squishy and easy to dive
dependent on landing skillshots, which good players dodge
weak against Abathur because Target Practice cannot be completed
evidence: measured damage 3223 per minute and siege 4079 per minute
owner_notes: Lots of poke damage from a mix of spells and autos. Minions and summons can block his abilities, and he depends on skillshots. Can jump terrain to escape in many situations, but high mobility dive heroes like Zeratul or Genji kill him easily. Dragon Arrow is an engage in big team fights or a disengage, best at choke points or on clumped teams. Low health. Weak at camps and wave clear, but the level 4 W talent gives decent objective or boss damage.

lens_notes.damage_delivery: Storm Bow arrows plus weaved Giant Slayer and Flawless Technique autos both carry damage.
lens_notes.damage_timing: Long range Storm Bow pokes through a fight; the burst is Dragon's Arrow plus a stack of arrows, but the standard role is poke.
lens_notes.damage_reliability: Thin linear arrows that minions and summons block (owner), so terrain angles matter.
lens_notes.escape: Natural Agility is a 25 second terrain jump, and owner says Zeratul or Genji still kill him.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Dragon's Arrow stun only, and Bullseye is a talent stun.
lens_notes.wave_clear_style: Owner reads him as weak at wave clear and camps; the level 4 W talent only helps from range. Owner read followed over the profile rating of 3.
lens_notes.camp_play: Owner: weak at camps; 4.4 camps per game measured is in line with other assassins.
lens_notes.objective_role: Level 4 W talent gives decent objective and boss damage (owner).
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Dragon's Arrow is an engage in big fights or a disengage, best at chokepoints or clumped teams (owner); Dragonstrike is rarely picked.
lens_notes.execution_demand: Icy Veins lists him hard to play, angles and skillshots only.
lens_notes.vulnerable_to: Mobile dive heroes (Zeratul, Genji) kill him easily (owner); nothing in the list covers being blocked by minions.

lens_gaps: no value for 'blocked by minions or summons' on lens vulnerable_to or damage_reliability
no value for an engage or disengage heroic on ultimate_role (Dragon's Arrow does both)
